metadata.description: Marketplace for the fynd-dyrka security plugin

plugins.name: fynd-dyrka
plugins.description: Security review in seven layers: SAST, secrets, dependencies, IaC, DAST, external recon of a live service, and platform — the real state of the production deployment. Orchestrates semgrep/gitleaks/osv-scanner/trivy/nuclei plus manual review of logic flaws (auth, IDOR, SSRF, races over money), availability and cost, MITRE mapping, and the agentic surface (LLM/MCP/RAG).
